title: Market Regime Council for Dynamic Credit Assignment in Multi-Agent LLM Decision Systems
abstract: arXiv:2605.24490v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM decision systems for portfolio management still lack a principled way to assign credit across specialist agents, remain vulnerable to cold-start dominance under regime shifts, and offer limited transparency into how final allocations are formed. We propose Market Regime Council (MRC), an online credit-assignment mechanism over coalitions of specialist agents, with portfolio management as the downstream task. MRC computes exact Shapley credits across all single, pairwise, and Grand-coalition outputs for online agent weighting. Instantiated with N=3 specialist agents, at each trading period, MRC recomputes coalition-based Shapley weights from exponentially weighted performance histories, uses a Bayesian adaptive mixture to stabilize early periods, applies regime-dependent multipliers to adjust agent authority, and records each rebalance through a five-layer causal trace. translated_title: 面向多智能体大语言模型决策系统中动态信用分配的市场体制委员会
translated_abstract: 用于投资组合管理的多智能体大语言模型决策系统仍然缺乏一种在专业智能体之间进行信用分配的原则性方法，在市场体制转换时容易受到冷启动主导的影响，并且对最终配置的形成过程缺乏透明度。我们提出了市场体制委员会（Market Regime Council, MRC），这是一种针对专业智能体联盟的在线信用分配机制，以投资组合管理作为下游任务。MRC 在所有单个、成对以及大联盟输出上计算精确的 Shapley 信用，用于智能体的在线加权。在实例化为 N=3 个专业智能体时，MRC 在每个交易周期从指数加权的历史表现中重新计算基于联盟的 Shapley 权重，使用贝叶斯自适应混合来稳定早期阶段，应用依赖于市场体制的乘数来调整智能体权限，并通过五层因果追踪记录每次再平衡。在 13 种加密资产上超过 1,037 个交易日的实验……
tldr: 本文提出了市场体制委员会（MRC），一种基于精确 Shapley 信用的在线信用分配机制，通过联盟绩效加权、贝叶斯自适应混合和体制依赖的权限乘数，解决了多智能体大语言模型投资组合管理系统中信用分配缺乏原则、冷启动主导和透明度不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Market Regime Council (MRC), an online credit-assignment mechanism that computes exact Shapley credits over specialist agent coalitions, using Bayesian adaptive mixtures and regime-dependent authority multipliers to address the lack of principled credit assignment, cold-start dominance, and limited transparency in multi-agent LLM portfolio management systems.
